items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: at one time I did a lot of work with Steven Sylvester who is an inventor you know that — he, you know he came to me and he said, “You know what I’m going to do is I’m going to build an instrument that can keep up with you.” And so our first concert

ctx.x: The Baroque flute you’re talking about.

Yeah, the Baroque flute, that’s right, the Baroque flute I do play that. The entire recorder family, I play that as well. Because I’ve been in several early music groups. So wow, I have a whole collection of instruments that I made that no one even has. Percussion instruments and so on that I play. So there I mean everybody can be an individual because I encourage people that are interested in it, you know, to build their own instrument you know. So that way then everybody has their own instrument. But you know…
they were going slow they were hitting each other like little bells and ringing and so on and so forth you know. So yeah, yeah, I mean I learn a lot from him man. You know, really.
